text: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ
transliteration: Astaghfiru-llah
meaning: I seek forgiveness from Allah, said three times. It is among the first things legislated right after the salam, it expiates sins and opens the doors of mercy.
sub: After completing the obligatory prayer - Hadith of Thawban in Muslim

text: اللهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
transliteration: Allahumma anta as-Salam wa minka as-salam, tabarakta ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram
meaning: O Allah, You are the Peace and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor. It is said after the istighfar and completes the dhikr after prayer, bringing inner peace.
sub: After saying Astaghfirullah three times - Hadith of Thawban in Muslim

text: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ
transliteration: Subhana-llah
meaning: Glory be to Allah, exalted is He above all imperfections and defects.
sub: After every obligatory prayer - Hadith of the people of the dwellings in Bukhari and Muslim

text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
transliteration: Alhamdulillah
meaning: All praise is due to Allah for all His apparent and hidden blessings; it fills the scales on the Day of Judgment.
sub: After every obligatory prayer - Hadith of the people of the dwellings

text: اللهُ أَكْبَرُ
transliteration: Allahu Akbar
meaning: Allah is Greater than everything; it completes the one hundred along with tasbih and tahmid.
sub: After every obligatory prayer - Hadith of the people of the dwellings

text: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ الْعَظِيمِ
transliteration: Subhana-llahi wa bihamdihi, Subhana-llahi al-Azim
meaning: Light on the tongue, heavy on the scales; it expiates sins and raises ranks.
sub: Light on the tongue, heavy on the scales - Hadith in Bukhari

text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
transliteration: La ilaha illa-llah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahu al-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir
meaning: There is no true god except Allah alone, with no partner; to Him belongs the dominion, to Him belongs all praise, and He is over all things competent - equivalent to freeing four slaves from the children of Ismail.
sub: Equivalent to freeing four from the children of Ismail - after every prayer

text: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ الْعَظِيمَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
transliteration: Astaghfiru-llaha al-Azeem wa atubu ilayh
meaning: I seek forgiveness from Allah the Almighty and repent to Him - whoever seeks forgiveness, Allah will forgive him even if his sins were like the foam of the sea.
sub: Whoever seeks forgiveness, Allah will forgive him - can be repeated after prayer or at any time

text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
transliteration: La ilaha illa-llah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahu al-mulku wa lahul-hamd, yuhyi wa yumitu wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir
meaning: He gives life and causes death, in His hand is all good, and He is over all things competent - especially said ten times after Maghrib and Fajr.
sub: Ten times after Maghrib and Fajr prayers

text: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ
transliteration: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
meaning: There is no power nor might except with Allah - a treasure from the treasures of Paradise, added after the tahlil in some narrations.
sub: After the main dhikr after prayer - Hadith of Ibn az-Zubayr in Muslim

text: آيَةُ الْكُرْسِيِّ
transliteration: Ayat al-Kursi
meaning: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence... (full Ayat al-Kursi) - the greatest verse in the Quran; whoever recites it after every prayer will not be prevented from entering Paradise except by death.
sub: After every obligatory prayer

text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ
transliteration: Allahumma salli ala Muhammad
meaning: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad ﷺ - the minimal form; whoever sends blessings upon him once, Allah sends blessings upon him ten times.
sub: The minimal blessing upon him ﷺ - increase it at all times

text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
transliteration: Allahumma salli wa sallim ala Nabiyyina Muhammad
meaning: O Allah, send peace and blessings upon our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ - whoever blesses me ten times, Allah blesses him one hundred times.
sub: Whoever blesses me ten times, Allah blesses him one hundred times

text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
transliteration: Allahumma salli ala Muhammad wa ala ali Muhammad kama sallayta ala Ibrahim wa ala ali Ibrahim innaka Hamidun Majid, Allahumma barik ala Muhammad wa ala ali Muhammad kama barakta ala Ibrahim wa ala ali Ibrahim innaka Hamidun Majid
meaning: The complete Ibrahimi Salawat (the best) - the most perfect form of sending blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ as used in the tashahhud.
sub: The Ibrahimi Salawat - the best that is reported in Bukhari and Muslim

text: صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
transliteration: Salla-llahu alayhi wa sallam
meaning: Allah's peace and blessings be upon him - blessings upon the Prophet are multiplied on Friday (one hundred times or more).
sub: On Friday the blessings upon the Prophet are multiplied

text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ
transliteration: La ilaha illa-llah
meaning: The best of all remembrance and the highest word of faith; it enters one into Paradise and expiates sins.
sub: The best of all remembrance - Hadith in Bukhari and Muslim

text: اللهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرًا وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا وَسُبْحَانَ اللهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
transliteration: Allahu akbar kabiran wal-hamdu lillahi kathiran wa subhana-llahi bukratan wa asila
meaning: Allah is the Greatest, abundant praise to Allah, glory be to Him morning and evening - from the remembrances of day and night.
sub: From the remembrances of day and night

text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
transliteration: La ilaha illa-llah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahu al-mulku wa lahul-hamd, yuhyi wa yumit wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir
meaning: There is no god but Allah alone; He gives life and causes death - ten times in the morning and evening.
sub: Ten times in the morning and evening

text: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
transliteration: Subhana-llahi wa bihamdihi
meaning: Whoever says it one hundred times, his sins are forgiven even if they were like the foam of the sea, and a palm tree is planted for him in Paradise.
sub: Whoever says it one hundred times, his sins are forgiven

text: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
transliteration: Subhana-llahi al-Azim wa bihamdihi
meaning: A palm tree is planted for him in Paradise, and it expiates sins.
sub: A palm tree is planted for him in Paradise

text: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَاللهُ أَكْبَرُ
transliteration: Subhan-Allah, Alhamdulillah, La ilaha illa-llah, Allahu Akbar
meaning: The four most beloved words to Allah; the scales are filled with them.
sub: The most beloved words to Allah

text: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
transliteration: Subhana-llahi wa bihamdihi adada khalqihi wa rida nafsihi wa zinata arshihi wa midada kalimatihi
meaning: Three times equals more than all other remembrance that day.
sub: Three times equals more than all other remembrance

text: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ
transliteration: Subhana Rabbiyal Azim
meaning: Tasbih during ruku' (bowing) - repeat three times or more.
sub: Tasbih of Ruku'

text: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْأَعْلَى
transliteration: Subhana Rabbiyal A'la
meaning: Tasbih during sujood (prostration) - repeat three times or more.
sub: Tasbih of Sujood

text: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
transliteration: Asbahna wa asbahal mulku lillah, wal-hamdu lillah
meaning: We have entered the morning and sovereignty belongs to Allah alone, and all praise is due to Allah.
sub: Say when you enter the morning

text: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna wa bika amsayna wa bika nahya wa bika namutu wa ilaykan-nushur
meaning: All our affairs are in the hand of Allah; He gives life, causes death, and to Him is the resurrection.
sub: Say when you enter the morning

text: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
transliteration: Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa anta, khalaqtani wa ana abduka...
meaning: The Master of Istighfar — whoever says it with certainty enters Paradise (during the day or night).
sub: The Master of Istighfar - Hadith in Bukhari

text: أَعُوذُ بِاللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
transliteration: Audhu billahi mina ash-Shaytani ar-Rajim
meaning: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed devil - protection from the whispers of Satan.
sub: Protection from the devil

text: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ
transliteration: Bismillahi ar-Rahmani ar-Rahim
meaning: Begin your day with the name of Allah - brings barakah in every action.
sub: Begin your day with the name of Allah

text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
transliteration: Allahumma inni asbahtu ush-hiduka wa ush-hidu hamalata arshika...
meaning: Said four times in the morning: it frees a quarter of the person from the Hellfire.
sub: Four times: frees a quarter from the Hellfire

text: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي
transliteration: Allahumma afini fi badani, Allahumma afini fi sam'i, Allahumma afini fi basari
meaning: O Allah, grant me well-being in my body, hearing, and sight - said three times.
sub: Three times

text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka al-afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah
meaning: One of the most comprehensive supplications for well-being in both worlds.
sub: Supplication for well-being in both worlds

text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni audhu bika minal hammi wal-hazan...
meaning: A comprehensive supplication to remove anxiety, sorrow, debt, laziness, and weakness - it removes worry and expands provision.
sub: Supplication for anxiety, sorrow, and debt

text: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
transliteration: Amsayna wa amsal mulku lillah wal-hamdu lillah
meaning: We have entered the evening and sovereignty belongs to Allah, and all praise is due to Allah.
sub: Say when you enter the evening

text: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
transliteration: Allahumma bika amsayna wa bika asbahna wa bika nahya wa bika namutu wa ilaykal-masir
meaning: The entire evening is in the hand of Allah.
sub: Say when you enter the evening

text: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي
transliteration: Allahumma afini fi badani, Allahumma afini fi sam'i, Allahumma afini fi basari
meaning: O Allah, grant me well-being in my body, hearing, and sight.
sub: Three times

text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَمْسَيْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
transliteration: Allahumma inni amsaytu ush-hiduka wa ush-hidu hamalata arshika...
meaning: Said four times in the evening: it frees a quarter of the person from the Hellfire.
sub: Four times: frees a quarter from the Hellfire

text: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
transliteration: Audhu bi kalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq
meaning: Whoever says it three times in the evening, no poison or venom will harm him that night.
sub: Three times when entering the evening

text: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
transliteration: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya
meaning: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live - said when lying down to sleep.
sub: Say when you lie down to sleep

text: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ
transliteration: Subhana-llah
meaning: Glory be to Allah - before sleep (33 times).
sub: Before sleeping

text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
transliteration: Alhamdulillah
meaning: All praise is due to Allah - before sleep (33 times).
sub: Before sleeping

text: اللهُ أَكْبَرُ
transliteration: Allahu Akbar
meaning: Allah is the Greatest - better for you than a servant (34 times to complete one hundred).
sub: Before sleep — better for you than a servant

text: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
transliteration: Allahumma qini adhabaka yawma tab'athu ibadak
meaning: Three times before sleeping - protection from the punishment on the Day of Resurrection.
sub: Three times before sleeping

text: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ
transliteration: Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilayk wa fawwadtu amri ilayk wa alja'tu zahri ilayk
meaning: Complete submission to Allah before sleep - then sleep in a state of wudu.
sub: Say when you lie down to sleep, then sleep upon wudu

text: اللَّهُمَّ بِاسْمِكَ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
transliteration: Allahumma bismika amutu wa ahya
meaning: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live - from the established sleep adhkar.
sub: When lying down

text: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ
transliteration: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
meaning: There is no power nor might except with Allah - a treasure from the treasures of Paradise; it helps in every difficult matter.
sub: A treasure from the treasures of Paradise

text: حَسْبُنَا اللهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
transliteration: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal Wakil
meaning: Allah is sufficient for us and the best Disposer of affairs - Ibrahim (peace be upon him) said it in the fire and it became coolness and peace.
sub: Said by Ibrahim in the fire

text: حَسْبِيَ اللهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
transliteration: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huwa, alayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa Rabbul arshil azim
meaning: Seven times in the morning and evening - complete sufficiency and reliance.
sub: Seven times in the morning and evening

text: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ
transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum, bi rahmatika astaghith
meaning: From the Beautiful Names of Allah (The Ever-Living, The Self-Sustaining) - it brings relief from every distress.
sub: From the Beautiful Names of Allah

text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni audhu bika minal hammi wal-hazan
meaning: Supplication for distress and anxiety - it removes worry and sorrow.
sub: Supplication for distress and anxiety

text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي
transliteration: Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathiran wa la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa anta...
meaning: The supplication of Abu Bakr as-Siddiq (may Allah be pleased with him) - comprehensive forgiveness.
sub: The supplication of Abu Bakr as-Siddiq

text: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الْغَفُورُ
transliteration: Rabbi ighfir li wa tub alayya innaka anta at-Tawwabul Ghafur
meaning: The Prophet ﷺ used to say it one hundred times in a sitting - repentance and forgiveness.
sub: The Prophet ﷺ would say it one hundred times in a gathering

text: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ
transliteration: Allahumma ighfir li dhanbi kullahu diqqahu wa jillahu
meaning: Comprehensive forgiveness for all sins, small and great.
sub: Comprehensive forgiveness for all sins

text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka al-afwa wal-afiyah
meaning: One of the most comprehensive supplications - pardon and well-being in religion, worldly life, and the Hereafter.
sub: One of the most comprehensive supplications

text: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanah wa fil-akhirati hasanah wa qina adhaban-nar
meaning: The supplication most frequently made by the Prophet ﷺ - goodness in this world and the Hereafter.
sub: The most frequent supplication of the Prophet ﷺ

text: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
transliteration: Subhanakallahumma wa bihamdika, ashhadu an la ilaha illa anta, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk
meaning: Expiation of the gathering - it expiates any vain talk that occurred in the gathering.
sub: Expiation of the gathering

text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal jannata wa audhu bika minan-nar
meaning: Whoever asks Allah for Paradise three times, Paradise itself says: O Allah, admit him to Paradise.
sub: Paradise itself asks Allah to admit him

text: بِسْمِ اللهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'a ismihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa huwas-sami'ul-alim
meaning: Whoever says it three times, nothing will harm him that day or night.
sub: Whoever says it three times, nothing will harm him

text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin
meaning: The supplication of Prophet Yunus (peace be upon him) from inside the whale - it relieves distress.
sub: The supplication of Prophet Yunus from inside the whale

text: اللهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ
transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm
meaning: Ayat al-Kursi — the greatest verse in the Quran; protection from the devil and barakah in provision.
sub: The greatest verse in the Book of Allah

text: قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ
transliteration: Qul huwa-llahu ahad
meaning: It equals one third of the Quran - three times in the morning and evening.
sub: Equals one third of the Quran

text: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ
transliteration: Qul audhu bi Rabbil-Falaq
meaning: The first Mu'awwidhah — protection from all evil.
sub: Three times in the morning and evening

text: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ
transliteration: Qul audhu bi Rabbin-Nas
meaning: The second Mu'awwidhah — protection from the whispers of devils.
sub: Three times in the morning and evening

text: رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
transliteration: Rabbi audhu bika min hamazatish-shayatin wa audhu bika Rabbi an yahdurun
meaning: Seeking refuge from the evil whisperings of the devils.
sub: Seeking refuge from the whisperings of devils

text: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
transliteration: Rabbi zidni ilma
meaning: My Lord, increase me in knowledge - repeat for barakah in knowledge.
sub: Supplication to increase in knowledge

text: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ كُلُّهُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ كُلُّهُ
transliteration: Allahumma lakal hamdu kulluhu wa lakas shukru kulluhu
meaning: Thanking Allah for His countless blessings - it increases the blessings.
sub: Thanking Allah for His countless blessings

text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ
transliteration: Alhamdulillahi hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarakan fih
meaning: It fills the scales on the Day of Judgment.
sub: Fills the scales on the Day of Judgment

text: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
transliteration: Allahumma a'inni ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni ibadatik
meaning: The advice of the Prophet ﷺ to Mu'adh ibn Jabal - the greatest advice.
sub: The advice of the Prophet ﷺ to Mu'adh

text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
transliteration: Alhamdulillahil-ladhi at'amana wa saqana wa ja'alana muslimin
meaning: All praise to Allah who fed us, gave us drink, and made us Muslims - said after eating and drinking.
sub: Say after eating and drinking

text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ رِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَعِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka rizqan tayyiban wa ilman nafi'an wa amalan mutaqabbala
meaning: Supplication for pure provision, beneficial knowledge, and accepted deeds - it brings barakah in rizq.
sub: Supplication for provision, knowledge and deeds

text: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا رَزَقْتَنِي وَقِنِي عَذَابَكَ
transliteration: Allahumma barik li fima razaqtani wa qini adhabak
meaning: Seeking blessings in what Allah has provided and protection from punishment.
sub: Seeking blessings in provision

text: تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللهِ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ
transliteration: Tawakkaltu alallah wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
meaning: Complete reliance upon Allah - it suffices the servant.
sub: Complete reliance upon Allah

text: اللَّهُمَّ يَسِّرْ وَلَا تُعَسِّرْ وَتَمِّمْ بِالْخَيْرِ
transliteration: Allahumma yassir wa la tu'assir wa tammim bil-khayr
meaning: Supplication for ease in all affairs and provision.
sub: Supplication for ease in all affairs

text: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
transliteration: Allahumma akfini bihalalika an haramika wa aghnini bifadlika amman siwaka
meaning: Supplication for paying off debt and abundant halal provision - it suffices with what is halal and enriches from what is haram.
sub: Supplication for paying off debt and halal provision

text: سُبُّوحٌ قُدُّوسٌ رَبُّ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ
transliteration: Subbuhun Quddusun Rabbul-mala'ikati war-Ruh
meaning: Most Glorious, Most Holy, Lord of the angels and the Spirit - said in ruku' and sujood, from the glorifications of the angels.
sub: From the glorifications of the angels - said in ruku' and sujood

text: سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْجَبَرُوتِ وَالْمَلَكُوتِ وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ وَالْعَظَمَةِ
transliteration: Subhana dhil-Jabaruti wal-Malakuti wal-Kibriya'i wal-Azamah
meaning: Glory be to the Owner of might, sovereignty, grandeur, and majesty - said in ruku' and sujood.
sub: From the adhkar of ruku' and sujood - Hadith in Abu Dawud and Nasa'i

text: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
transliteration: Subhanakallahumma Rabbana wa bihamdika, Allahumma ighfir li
meaning: The Prophet ﷺ used to say this frequently in his ruku' and sujood in compliance with the Quran's command.
sub: The Prophet ﷺ used to say it frequently in ruku' and sujood

text: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ سُبْحَانَ اللهِ الْعَظِيمِ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ
transliteration: Subhana-llahi wa bihamdihi Subhana-llahil-Azim Astaghfiru-llah
meaning: Combining tasbih and istighfar - light on the tongue, heavy on the scales, together with seeking forgiveness.
sub: Combining tasbih and istighfar

text: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ مِلْءَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الْأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَيْءٍ بَعْدُ
transliteration: Subhana-llahi mil'as-samawati wa mil'al-ardi wa mil'a ma shi'ta min shay'in ba'd
meaning: Glorification that fills the heavens and the earth - from the dhikr when rising from ruku'.
sub: From the dhikr when rising from ruku'

text: اللهُ أَكْبَرُ اللهُ أَكْبَرُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَاللهُ أَكْبَرُ اللهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلِلَّهِ الْحَمْدُ
transliteration: Allahu Akbar Allahu Akbar la ilaha illa-llah, wa-llahu Akbar Allahu Akbar wa lillahil-hamd
meaning: Takbirat of Eid and the blessed days - fills the heart with faith and glorification.
sub: Takbirat of Eid and the days of Tashriq

text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ الْمُبِينُ
transliteration: La ilaha illa-llahul-Malikul-Haqqul-Mubin
meaning: There is no god but Allah, the True King, the Manifest - tahlil with the attributes of Allah the King.
sub: Tahlil with the attributes of Allah

text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَلَا نَعْبُدُ إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الْحَسَنُ
transliteration: La ilaha illa-llah wa la na'budu illa iyyah, lahun-ni'matu wa lahul-fadlu wa lahuth-thana'ul-hasan
meaning: Said when leaving prayer - Hadith of Ibn az-Zubayr in Muslim.
sub: When leaving prayer - Hadith in Muslim

text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ
transliteration: La ilaha illa-llahu wahdah, anjaza wa'dah, wa nasara abdah, wa hazamal-ahzaba wahdah
meaning: The Prophet's ﷺ supplication on Safa, Marwa, and Arafat - three times.
sub: The Prophet's ﷺ supplication on Safa and Marwa

text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَآلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
transliteration: Allahumma salli ala Muhammadin abdika wa rasulika kama sallayta ala Ibrahim...
meaning: Another version of the Ibrahimi Salawat from the narration of Abu Humayd as-Sa'idi in Bukhari.
sub: Narration of Abu Humayd as-Sa'idi in Bukhari

text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
transliteration: Allahumma salli ala Muhammadin wa azwajihi wa dhurriyyatihi...
meaning: A form that includes the Prophet's ﷺ wives and offspring - from the narration of Abu Humayd in Bukhari and Muslim.
sub: From the narration of Abu Humayd in Bukhari and Muslim

text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيمًا
transliteration: Allahumma salli ala Muhammad an-Nabiyyil-Ummi wa ala alihi wa sallim taslima
meaning: A form mentioning the attribute of the unlettered Prophet ﷺ with complete salutation.
sub: Blessings upon the unlettered Prophet ﷺ

text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni audhu bika minal hammi wal-hazan...
meaning: A comprehensive supplication to remove anxiety, sorrow, debt, laziness and weakness in the evening.
sub: Supplication for anxiety, sorrow and debt - evening

text: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
transliteration: Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa anta, khalaqtani wa ana abduka...
meaning: The Master of Istighfar in the evening — whoever says it with certainty and dies that night enters Paradise.
sub: The Master of Istighfar - evening - Hadith in Bukhari

text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah...
meaning: Comprehensive supplication for well-being in religion, worldly life, family and wealth.
sub: Comprehensive supplication for well-being - evening

text: بِسْمِ اللهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'a ismihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa huwas-sami'ul-alim
meaning: Whoever says it three times, nothing will harm him that evening or night.
sub: Three times when entering the evening

text: رَضِيتُ بِاللهِ رَبًّا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا
transliteration: Raditu billahi Rabban wa bil-Islami dinan wa bi Muhammadin salla-llahu alayhi wa sallama nabiyya
meaning: Whoever says it three times in the evening, it is a right upon Allah to please him on the Day of Judgment.
sub: Three times in the evening

text: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
transliteration: Allahumma ma asbaha bi min ni'matin aw bi ahadin min khalqika faminka wahdaka...
meaning: Whoever says it in the morning has completed the gratitude of his day.
sub: Completing the gratitude of the day - Hadith in Abu Dawud

text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ
transliteration: Alhamdulillahi ala kulli hal
meaning: All praise is due to Allah in every condition, in prosperity and adversity.
sub: Praise in every condition

text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
transliteration: Alhamdulillahil-ladhi bi ni'matihi tatimmus-salihat
meaning: Said when something pleasing happens - from the adhkar of joy and blessings.
sub: When something pleasing happens - Hadith in Ibn Majah

text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَمْلِكُهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlika wa rahmatika fa innahu la yamlikuha illa ant
meaning: Asking Allah for His bounty and mercy, for none possesses them except Him.
sub: Asking Allah for His bounty and mercy

text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا وَاسِعًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا وَشِفَاءً مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka ilman nafi'an wa rizqan wasi'an wa amalan mutaqabbalan wa shifa'an min kulli da'
meaning: A comprehensive dua for the best of this world and the Hereafter: knowledge, provision, accepted deeds, and healing.
sub: Comprehensive dua for the best of both worlds

text: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِي حُبَّكَ وَحُبَّ مَنْ يُحِبُّكَ وَحُبَّ عَمَلٍ يُقَرِّبُنِي إِلَى حُبِّكَ
transliteration: Allahumma arzuqni hubbaka wa hubba man yuhibbuka wa hubba amalin yuqarribuni ila hubbik
meaning: Supplication for the love of Allah and the love of those who love Him - one of the greatest provisions.
sub: Supplication for the love of Allah - Hadith in Tirmidhi

text: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي وَعَافِنِي
transliteration: Allahumma ighfir li warhamni wahdini warzuqni wa afini
meaning: A comprehensive dua between the two prostrations: forgiveness, mercy, guidance, provision, and well-being.
sub: Dua between the two prostrations - Hadith in Abu Dawud

text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-huda wat-tuqa wal-afafa wal-ghina
meaning: The Prophet's ﷺ supplication seeking guidance, piety, chastity, and self-sufficiency.
sub: From the Prophet's ﷺ supplications - Hadith in Muslim

text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الثَّبَاتَ فِي الْأَمْرِ وَالْعَزِيمَةَ عَلَى الرُّشْدِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukat-thabata fil-amri wal-azimata alar-rushd
meaning: Supplication seeking steadfastness and determination upon guidance in all matters.
sub: Supplication for steadfastness and guidance

text: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
transliteration: Ya Muqallibal-qulubi thabbit qalbi ala dinik
meaning: The most frequent supplication of the Prophet ﷺ - asking for the heart to remain steadfast on faith.
sub: The most frequent dua of the Prophet ﷺ - Hadith in Tirmidhi

text: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي وَسَدِّدْنِي
transliteration: Allahumma ihdini wa saddidni
meaning: A concise supplication seeking guidance and correctness in all matters.
sub: Supplication for guidance and correctness - Hadith in Muslim

text: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِنْ لِسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
transliteration: Rabbishrahli sadri wa yassirli amri wahlul uqdatan min lisani yafqahu qawli
meaning: The supplication of Prophet Musa (peace be upon him) - for expanding the chest, easing affairs, and eloquent speech.
sub: The supplication of Prophet Musa - Surah Taha

text: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِنْ رُسُلِهِ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
transliteration: Amanar-Rasulu bima unzila ilayhi min Rabbihi wal-mu'minun...
meaning: The last verses of Surah al-Baqarah - whoever recites them at night, they will suffice him.
sub: Last verses of Surah al-Baqarah - whoever recites them at night, they suffice him

text: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbana la tu'akhidhna in nasina aw akhta'na...
meaning: Continuation of the last verses of Surah al-Baqarah - Allah said: I have done so.
sub: Last verses of al-Baqarah - Allah said: I have done so

text: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
transliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin waj'alna lil-muttaqina imama
meaning: The supplication of the servants of the Most Merciful in Surah al-Furqan - for the righteousness of family and offspring.
sub: Supplication of the servants of the Most Merciful - Surah al-Furqan

text: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
transliteration: Rabbi hab li min ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibah innaka sami'ud-du'a'
meaning: The supplication of Prophet Zakariya (peace be upon him) asking for righteous offspring - Surah Ali Imran.
sub: Supplication of Prophet Zakariya - Surah Ali Imran
